newsitem.title: USA: Kerr-Mcgee to up titanium dioxide in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Kerr-Mcgee to up titanium dioxide in Europe.

text.p: Kerr-McGee Chemical Corp's Pigments Ltd unit said Tuesday it would increase prices for TRONOX titanium dioxide in Europe effective July 1 to bring prices in line with world levels.
The price for titanium dioxide in the United Kingdom and Ireland will increase by seven percent and in the remaining European countries by 10 percent, the company said.
The percentage difference reflects more stable market prices and stronger currencies in the UK and Ireland and will bring European prices in line with world-price levels, Kerr-McGee said.

Strong demand through the first half of the year has resulted in heavy shipments and declining producer inventories. Shipments are expected to remain firm through the end of the year, the company said.
